title: Pilot
description: A documentary crew arrives at a Scranton paper company just as rumors of downsizing reach the office, and the regional manager works hard to make a good first impression.

title: Diversity Day
description: After Michael's own insensitive joke gets the branch in trouble, a corporate-mandated diversity seminar goes sideways when Michael decides to run his own version of it instead.

title: The Dundies
description: Michael takes the staff to a nearby restaurant for the office's own homegrown awards show, determined to give everyone a night to remember.

title: Sexual Harassment
description: A new corporate harassment policy collides with Michael's love of off-color jokes, and a visit from his old buddy Todd Packer doesn't help matters.

title: The Fire
description: A small fire breaks out in the break room, and the resulting evacuation gives several coworkers a block of unsupervised downtime to work through their own anxieties and jealousies.

title: The Fight
description: After weeks of Dwight bragging about his martial-arts training, Michael challenges him to a showdown at the dojo, and the whole office wants to know who will win.

title: The Client
description: Michael and Jan court an important county client over dinner at a chain restaurant, while back at the office Pam stumbles onto a screenplay Michael has been writing.

title: Performance Review
description: Review day brings Jan back to the office, much to Michael's nervous excitement, and an afternoon of reading suggestion-box notes aloud goes about as well as you'd expect.

title: Email Surveillance
description: New email monitoring lets Michael discover that Jim is hosting a party he wasn't invited to, and he can't resist finding a way to show up anyway.

title: Christmas Party
description: Michael scraps the office's planned Secret Santa in favor of a cutthroat Yankee Swap, and the mix-up over gifts ends up revealing more about everyone's relationships than intended.

title: Booze Cruise
description: The branch takes an awkward team-building trip aboard a booze cruise, where Michael's attempt to bond with the staff competes with Jim's growing feelings for Pam.

title: The Secret
description: After accidentally letting slip that someone in the office has a crush, Michael's clumsy attempt to keep things quiet only makes everyone more suspicious of each other.

title: Boys and Girls
description: Jan runs a workplace seminar for the women of the office, so Michael holds a rival session for the men down in the warehouse.

title: Valentine's Day
description: Michael's Valentine's Day is derailed by a breakup, while the office puts together a short in-house film that ends up revealing a surprising amount about the people who made it.

title: Dwight's Speech
description: Dwight wins a regional sales award and has to give an acceptance speech at a convention, despite being terrified of public speaking.

title: Take Your Daughter to Work Day
description: The office fills up with employees' kids for the day, and Michael's attempt to entertain them with a talent show reveals just how much he craves everyone's approval.

title: Michael's Birthday
description: Michael expects a big office celebration for his birthday, and his growing disappointment when it doesn't materialize pushes him into some increasingly odd behavior.

title: Casino Night
description: Michael hosts a charity casino night in the warehouse and somehow ends up with two dates, while Jim works up the nerve to tell Pam something important.

title: The Convention
description: Michael and Dwight head to a paper convention in Philadelphia, where Michael reunites with Jim and throws a hotel-room party that doesn't go as planned.

title: The Coup
description: Jan catches Michael screening movies for the staff during work hours, and Dwight sees an opening to make a play for the manager's job.

title: Grief Counseling
description: When a former boss dies unexpectedly, Michael insists the office work through its grief, and ends up organizing a funeral for an unlikely stand-in.

title: Initiation
description: Dwight puts the new temp through a strange rite of passage out at the family beet farm, while back at the office a sugar-fueled holiday sends Michael's afternoon off the rails.

title: Diwali
description: Kelly invites the office to a Diwali celebration, where Michael badly misreads the occasion and makes a very public gesture toward his girlfriend.

title: Branch Closing
description: Word spreads that the Scranton branch is about to be shut down, and the staff react in very different ways while corporate decides its fate.

title: The Merger
description: Staff from a shuttered branch join the Scranton office, and Michael's homemade welcome efforts make the transition far more awkward than it needed to be.

title: The Convict
description: Michael learns that one of the warehouse workers served time and decides the office needs a lesson about prison life, while Andy makes his move on Pam.

title: A Benihana Christmas
description: Michael brings two dates to the office Christmas party while Angela and Pam wage a quiet battle over whose party decorations and traditions will win out.

title: Back from Vacation
description: Michael returns from a tropical getaway eager to share his new island attitude, while a revealing vacation photo makes its way around the office.

title: Traveling Salesmen
description: Michael pairs off different salespeople for a day of client visits, and the odd pairings expose some unexpected tension and camaraderie among the sales team.

title: The Return
description: Oscar comes back from his time away and Dwight tries to find his way back from a job at an office-supply store, while Andy's nonstop efforts to impress Michael wear everyone down.

title: Ben Franklin
description: Michael plans a bachelor party for Bob Vance while the women of the office get a very different kind of entertainer, and Jim and Pam struggle to read each other.

title: Phyllis' Wedding
description: Phyllis's wedding day turns into a stage for Michael's need for attention, as he takes on a role nobody really gave him.

title: Cocktails
description: Michael and the staff attend Jan's dinner party, where tensions boil over and a few uncomfortable truths come out after one too many cocktails.

title: Safety Training
description: Feeling upstaged by the warehouse's safety training, Michael sets out to prove office work is dangerous too, with a stunt on the roof.

title: Product Recall
description: A batch of paper ships with an embarrassing watermark, sending the office into damage control as different departments try to calm angry customers.

title: Women's Appreciation
description: After a scare in the parking lot, Michael takes the women of the office out for an afternoon to show his appreciation, with mixed results.

title: Beach Games
description: Michael runs a day of beach competitions to choose his successor, and Pam surprises everyone with a long-overdue declaration.

title: The Job
description: Michael prepares to interview for a corporate job in New York, unaware that two of his own employees are competing for the same position.

title: Launch Party
description: The office celebrates the launch of the company's new website, while a dispute over a pizza order spirals into an awkward standoff with the delivery driver.

title: Money
description: Deep in debt, Michael takes on a second job to make ends meet, while Jim and Pam spend a getaway weekend at an unusual bed-and-breakfast.

title: Local Ad
description: Unimpressed by the generic commercial corporate hands him, Michael rallies the staff to write, cast and shoot an ad of their own.

title: The Deposition
description: Michael is called to testify in Jan's lawsuit against the company and has to decide whose side he is really on.

title: Chair Model
description: Michael becomes fixated on the woman pictured in an office-furniture catalog and goes looking for her, with a reluctant Dwight along for the ride.

title: Night Out
description: Michael and Dwight visit Ryan in New York for a night of clubbing, while back in Scranton the staff end up locked inside the office after hours.

title: Goodbye, Toby
description: On Toby's last day before moving to Costa Rica, Michael throws him a going-away party he can barely bring himself to attend, while a major relationship milestone unfolds elsewhere in the office.

title: Weight Loss
description: The branch takes on a months-long weight-loss competition tied to the company's health plan, while Michael quietly starts a long-distance relationship with the corporate HR representative.

title: Business Ethics
description: A workplace-ethics seminar turns into an uncomfortable confession circle, while Jim sets out to log exactly how much company time Dwight spends on personal business.

title: Baby Shower
description: Michael throws a baby shower for Jan, who is having a child on her own, and finds himself unsure of where he fits in.

title: Crime Aid
description: After the office is burglarized, Michael organizes a charity auction to make up the losses, while he and Holly try to keep their relationship quiet.

title: Employee Transfer
description: Corporate moves Holly to another branch, so Michael and Darryl drive her there themselves on a road trip that becomes one long, reluctant goodbye.

title: Customer Survey
description: Jim and Dwight are stunned by their low customer-survey scores, and the hunt for the cause uncovers a petty act of sabotage.

title: Stress Relief
description: Dwight's overzealous fire-safety drill traumatizes the office, prompting corporate to send in a stress-management specialist whose techniques go over about as well as you'd expect.

title: Lecture Circuit
description: Michael hits the road to give motivational talks at other branches, and a stop near Holly tests his resolve.

title: The Michael Scott Paper Company
description: Michael gets his brand-new paper company off the ground from a cramped rented space, while his old branch adjusts to life without him.

title: Heavy Competition
description: Michael's new paper company and his old branch battle over clients, while Jim and Pam start planning their wedding.

title: Café Disco
description: Michael turns an empty office downstairs into a dance spot to lift everyone's mood, while Jim and Pam rethink how they want to get married.

title: Niagara
description: Jim and Pam's wedding weekend at Niagara Falls is upended by travel chaos and old grudges, even as the ceremony itself still manages to come together.

title: The Lover
description: Jim and Pam are blindsided by a piece of news about Michael's love life that turns out to be far more personal than anyone expected.

title: Murder
description: As bad news about the company's future looms, Michael distracts the staff with an elaborate murder-mystery game.

title: Secret Santa
description: Michael sulks when someone else gets to play Santa at the holiday party, and rumors about the company's future put a damper on the celebration.

title: The Banker
description: A banker reviewing the company's finances interviews the staff, and Michael leans on the office's colorful history to make an impression.

title: Sabre
description: A new parent company arrives with strict rules and a painfully earnest welcome video, while Michael and Jim seek out a former boss for advice on the new regime.

title: St. Patrick's Day
description: The CEO's extended stay in Scranton collides with Jim's first day back from paternity leave, and Michael's holiday plans depend on whether she'll let everyone go home.

title: Nepotism
description: Michael refuses to fire his hopelessly unhelpful nephew, even as the rest of the office grows more and more fed up with the new hire.

title: Andy's Play
description: Andy invites the office to his community-theater production, and Michael has trouble accepting that he isn't in the show.

title: Sex Ed
description: A health scare sends Michael on a mission to contact his exes, and an office seminar on safe practices quickly goes off the rails.

title: Costume Contest
description: A Halloween costume contest with an underwhelming prize turns surprisingly competitive, while Michael comes face to face with a salesman he once considered his biggest rival.

title: The Ultimatum
description: Michael waits anxiously while Holly decides the future of her current relationship, and the staff try to keep his mind off it.

title: The Seminar
description: Andy hosts a seminar for local small-business owners and recruits his coworkers as guest speakers, with predictably uneven results.

title: Threat Level Midnight
description: The office finally gathers to watch the action movie Michael spent years making, starring many of his coworkers.

title: Michael's Last Dundies
description: Michael hosts one final round of his homemade awards, and the staff find a way to show him what he has meant to them.

title: Goodbye, Michael
description: Michael quietly wraps up his final day at the branch ahead of schedule, slipping away to say a real goodbye to Pam before anyone else realizes he's leaving for good.

title: The Inner Circle
description: The new manager picks a favored circle of employees, leaving the rest of the office scrambling to work out how to get in.

title: Garden Party
description: Andy throws a formal garden party at his parents' home to impress the new CEO, and Dwight relies on an etiquette guide that isn't quite what it claims to be.

title: Spooked
description: Halloween at the office takes a strange turn when the new CEO asks everyone to share what scares them most.

title: Doomsday
description: Dwight sets up a system that will report the office to the CEO if too many mistakes pile up, leaving everyone scrambling to get through a flawless day.

title: Pam's Replacement
description: With Pam about to go on maternity leave, her temporary replacement turns out to be a little too much like her.

title: Christmas Wishes
description: Andy promises to grant every employee's Christmas wish at the holiday party, but tension between the important women in his life complicates the night.

title: Pool Party
description: The CEO throws one last party at his mansion's pool before selling it, and the staff can't resist exploring every room.

title: Jury Duty
description: Jim's explanation for a long absence from work doesn't quite add up, and the office isn't happy when it learns the truth.

title: Test the Store
description: In Florida, Dwight readies a new retail store for its grand opening with Jim's reluctant help, while back in Scranton Andy tries to recover from an embarrassing moment.

title: Get the Girl
description: Andy drives all the way to Florida on a romantic mission, while a newcomer takes advantage of his absence back in Scranton.

title: Angry Andy
description: Andy comes back from Florida to find his job has gone to someone else, and his frustration builds until it boils over.

title: New Guys
description: Two new hires join the office and remind everyone a little too much of some familiar faces, while Pam weighs a change of her own.

title: Roy's Wedding
description: Jim and Pam attend Roy's wedding, where an unexpected toast catches Pam off guard.

title: Work Bus
description: Andy moves the whole office onto a rented bus for the day, turning an ordinary workday into a road trip.

title: Here Comes Treble
description: Andy's old college a cappella group stops by the office for a reunion, while Halloween festivities fill the rest of the day.

title: Lice
description: An outbreak of lice sweeps through the office and suspicion lands on the wrong person, while the real source tries hard to keep a low profile.

title: Customer Loyalty
description: A work trip makes Jim miss an important family moment, putting fresh strain on things at home, while Dwight and Darryl take a road trip of their own.

title: Moving On
description: Pam interviews for a job in Philadelphia, while back in Scranton Andy's return from a long absence stirs up trouble.

title: The Farm
description: A death in the family brings Dwight back together with his estranged siblings, and he tries to convince them to stay and run the family farm with him.

title: Promos
description: The office gets a first look at promotional clips for the documentary, and the reactions range from thrilled to horrified.

title: Livin' the Dream
description: Andy walks away to chase fame, Dwight finally gets a promotion he has wanted for years, and Jim rethinks his own path.

title: A.A.R.M.
description: Dwight sets out to choose his own assistant before the documentary airs, while Andy chases a spot on a televised singing competition.

title: Finale
description: A year after the documentary airs, the whole extended Dunder Mifflin family reunites in Scranton for a panel discussion and one last chance to reflect on their years together.
